{{Quote|Not only is Etsero still paying, but his gambling house is now being used to launder credits for Imperial interests in that sector of the galaxy.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
The '''Yataga sector''' was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adner]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Discovered 5,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Adner was eventually transformed into an entertainment and pleasure world, and the Adnerem [[Etsero]] owned the largest [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the planet, ''[[The Red Lisken]]''. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Etsero found that his debt to the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|late]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] had been transferred to an unnamed party allied with the fragmented [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and ''The Red Lisken'' was subsequently used to launder [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Imperial interests in the Yataga [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

==Description==
The Yataga [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Yataga sector bordered the [[Hythrope sector/Legends|Hythrope]] and [[Jurzan sector/Legends|Jurzan sectors]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]] [[spinward]], and the [[Woostri sector/Legends|Woostri sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. Together with the Kira and Woostri sectors, the Yataga sector formed the Expansion Region's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border, neighboring the [[Var Hagen sector/Legends|Var Hagen sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" /> The Yataga sector was home to the [[Adner system/Legends|Adner system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|In an attempt to stop these illegal activities, an agent was dispatched to Etsero's den, ''The Red Lisken''. He never reported in and it is believed he may have met with foul play at Etsero's hands.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WbC" />}}
After the<ref name="WbC" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], [[Etsero]], the [[Adnerem]] owner of the largest [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the<ref name="WbC" /> Yataga sector<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adner]], discovered that his debt to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had been transferred to an unnamed party allied with the fragmented [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Etsero's casino, ''[[The Red Lisken]]'', was used to launder [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Imperial interests in the<ref name="WbC" /> Yataga sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

In order to put an end to the crimes being carried out in ''The Red Lisken'',<ref name="WbC" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] dispatched an [[Unidentified New Republic agent (The Red Liskin)|agent]] to Adner; however, the agent never reported in with his superiors and was suspected to have been dealt with by Etsero. New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] subsequently mentioned the Imperial-allied criminal operations in the Yataga sector in ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.<ref name="WbC" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Etsero runs the largest gambling house on the pleasure planet of Adner.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WbC" />}}
The Adner [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the Yataga sector<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the terrestrial planet Adner. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]],<ref name="Journal11" /> [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] Adnerem [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|12|Adnerem}}</ref> Adner was discovered by a [[Unidentified Duros scout|Duros scout]] 5,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Three thousand years later, the Adnerem transformed their homeworld into a<ref name="Journal11" /> famous<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> entertainment<ref name="Journal11" /> and pleasure world.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sector containing Adner was first indirectly mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The sector was later identified as the Yataga sector in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares M-16, N-15, and N-16.<ref name="Expansion" />
